actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_company_data.description: Given a company name, LinkedIn username, or website, fetch comprehensive company info.
actions.get_company_data.props.company_u: Provide the username from the company's LinkedIn URL (e.g., 'microsoft').
actions.get_company_data.props.company_w: Provide the company's official website URL.
actions.get_company_data.props.request_i: If a previous run timed out, paste the Request ID here to get the result.
actions.get_job_result.description: Check a MagicalAPI job once by its Request ID and return its result if it is ready.
The Request ID returned when the job was started.
actions.get_job_result.props.service.des: The service that created the job.
actions.get_profile_data.description: Given a LinkedIn profile username, retrieve comprehensive profile data.

actions.get_profile_data.props.request_i: If a previous run timed out, paste the Request ID here to get the result.
